# Synthetic INF-02 fixture: fixed replica counts that no autoscaler targets.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: shop
spec:
  replicas: 4
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: web}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: web}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: example/web:1.0
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: queue
spec:
  serviceName: queue
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: queue}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: queue}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: queue
          image: example/queue:1.0
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: List
items:
  - apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    metadata:
      name: api
    spec:
      replicas: 2
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
            - name: api
              image: example/api:1.0
---
# The HPA targets a different Deployment name, and the Rollout below is a different kind.
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: web-hpa
  namespace: shop
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: web-v2
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: canary
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: canary
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 6
---
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: canary
spec:
  replicas: 5
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: canary
          image: example/canary:1.0
